basis: E3 (appendix C8.5): every row id of the family is hit >= 5 times in the union of the native checklist runs and the golden replay, or is listed in not_natively_reachable with the golden or unit test that drives it. Keys are `<site>.<row ordinal>` as in the summary's per_row (a suffixed row keeps its number and adds 100 per suffix step: R203.3a is 203.103). The list is reviewed with each cutover PR.

delegated.why: decides a reply another site returns, so it closes as the announced no-reply close and has no `matched`; its E3 credit is `matched + delegated` (`delegated` counts the verified delegated closes); the receiving site's rows carry the reply (#1173 `replay::DELEGATED_ROWS`)
